record.paper_title: Developments, Applications and Open Problems in Fixed Point Theory
record.original_question: Let K be a weakly compact convex subset of a Banach space. Does K necessarily have the fixed point property for strictly contractive self-maps, meaning that every mapping T: K -> K satisfying ||T x - T y|| < ||x - y|| for all distinct x,y in K must have a fixed point in K?

evidence.quote: Two more open problems suggested by Kirk: Kirk says 'There are many open problems in metric fixed point theory, but two have frustrated me over the years because of their simplicity and yet seeming intractability'. Problem 1: Does a weakly compact convex subset K of a Banach space have the fixed point property for strictly contractive mappings (that is, mappings T: K -> K for which ||Tx - Ty|| < ||x - y||, x,y in K, x != y)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a (real) Banach space with norm $\|\cdot\|$, and let $K \subseteq X$ be a nonempty weakly compact convex subset. A self-map $T : K \to K$ is called strictly contractive if
$$\|Tx - Ty\| < \|x - y\| \quad \text{for all } x, y \in K \text{ with } x \neq y.$$
Determine whether $K$ necessarily has the fixed point property for strictly contractive mappings: that is, must every strictly contractive self-map $T : K \to K$ have a (necessarily unique) fixed point in $K$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a long-standing open problem attributed to W. A. Kirk, repeatedly listed among the well-known unresolved questions in metric fixed point theory. No search result located indicates a positive or negative resolution; it continues to be cited as open in surveys and problem lists.

status_evidence.title: Some questions in metric fixed point theory (Kirk)
status_evidence.snippet: Kirk lists open problems in metric fixed point theory, including the question of whether weakly compact convex subsets of Banach spaces have the fixed point property for strictly contractive maps.
status_evidence.claim: Stated as an open problem by Kirk.

status_evidence.title: Fixed points and approximate fixed points in product spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the fixed point property for strictly contractive mappings in product spaces, treating it as an open question in general.
status_evidence.claim: Treated as still open in subsequent literature.
